### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/objectql`, touching **8** documentable anchor(s).

**6** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`  _(via executionContext (literal, a string literal in seedUserGrants; a string literal in transaction))_
- `content/docs/api/error-handling-server.mdx`  _(via ScopedContext (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx`  _(via ScopedContext (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/automation/jobs.mdx`  _(via executionContext (literal, a string literal in seedUserGrants; a string literal in transaction))_
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`  _(via ScopedContext (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx`  _(via executionContext (literal, a string literal in seedUserGrants; a string literal in transaction))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **231** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **166** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **166**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **107** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **21** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cd43416f58df30912aeba31abf78863e5731baff` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `17f5a3ebe6ac11abaac3eb5a70c95a62b90fea0e` — the merge of head `c39cb11f89ba5b9e567d070066e0455844b6f733` into base `cd43416f58df30912aeba31abf78863e5731baff`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 17f5a3ebe6ac11abaac3eb5a70c95a62b90fea0e && git checkout 17f5a3ebe6ac11abaac3eb5a70c95a62b90fea0e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin cd43416f58df30912aeba31abf78863e5731baff c39cb11f89ba5b9e567d070066e0455844b6f733 && git checkout -B drift-repro cd43416f58df30912aeba31abf78863e5731baff && git merge --no-ff c39cb11f89ba5b9e567d070066e0455844b6f733

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cd43416f58df30912aeba31abf78863e5731baff
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs cd43416f58df30912aeba31abf78863e5731baff` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 · round 1 · head `9ffb6d5e` · 2026-11-08T21:04Z

**Verdict: ACCEPT** (#30020 §5 item S1; `Refs #30020`, the series continues with E4 `delete`).

- **Rule A held** (ruling 6687865760). `ScopedContextHost` gains `readonly facade: ScopedContext`, installed as `facade: instance`. The two moved bodies read `this.facade` exactly where they read a bare `this` (`return this` ×2 in the grants seed; `callback(this, { owned: false })` on the no-transaction path). State stays on the facade.
- **Bodies verbatim otherwise.** `seedUserGrants` and `transaction` in `engine-scoped-context.ts` match `main`'s bodies line for line: the D2 ambient join, the `require: true` refusal, the `runOpenedUnit` unit, and rollback through `redactPropagatedDriverFault(rolledBackRefusal(…))`. The imports moved with them, and `engine.ts` drops the now-unused ones.
- **Proofs.** `--verify` undo is byte-exact against `origin/main`. The emitted `.d.ts` is identical (sha256 equal). objectql 572 / 11616 equals base. The facade gate drops 11 → 9 with exactly the two S1 rows removed from `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json`.
- **Codemod.** It adds `--scoped --members Class#member`, with R1 on an instance host and R9 (a symbol key `[NAME]` → a camelCase facet member). Its self-test goes 211/13 from a base of 186/12, and each of the 3 ablations was measured red.
- **Nit, accepted.** The stubs drop `async` and return the facet's promise. `.d.ts` is unchanged, and `scopedContextHost.of(this)` cannot throw synchronously on a constructed instance, so callers observe nothing different.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/objectql` patch with `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: the published JS changes, and AGENTS.md's "none takes patch" applies.

**Rulings on open_questions:**
1. The codemod spelling (`--scoped --members Class#member`) and R9's camelCase naming → **keep (A).** E4–E6 reuse them.
2. A separate contract review for the codemod → **not owed.** `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` hits no review face (no published schema, no governed path, no narrowing), and `check-governed-merges` reads 0 of 5 paths governed.

Landing: after CI is green on `9ffb6d5e`.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [42530245440](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/42530245440) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Test Core (7/8)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/42530245440/job/128883145036)** — 失败步骤: Run this shard's tests

  ```
  @objectstack/plugin-security:test:  FAIL  src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts > [ADR-0090 D12] a delegated answer about a user the caller cannot read does not depend on that user's existe
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/plugin-security:test: Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- `src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` — 24h 窗口内只有本 PR 撞到过，暂不汇总（再有一个不同 PR 撞到就会自动开汇总 issue）。
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 8 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。

## Queue failure 42530245440: not this PR's (timeout under load) · Stamped 2026-11-08T23:02Z

- **What failed.** Test Core (7/8): `plugin-security` `src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` › posture 'isolated' › "the 4 states get, at every door, …" (`:878`). It hit `Test timed out in 5000ms`; it is a timeout, not an assertion. The queue shard was heavily loaded: the package ran 552s with import 1061s, and this file took 132s for its 193 tests.
- **Why it isn't this diff.** The test reaches `ObjectQL` (the engine changed here), so I measured it rather than assumed. I ran the same file 3× on head `c39cb11f` and 3× with `packages/objectql/src` reverted to the merge base `8c9260f7` (dist rebuilt each way; control: the facet name occurs 2× in head `dist/index.mjs`, 0× in base). All 6 runs passed 106/106. The timed-out test takes the same time on both sides:
  - head: single 728–767ms · group 813–1087ms · isolated 792–1109ms
  - base: single 709–714ms · group 796–1088ms · isolated 834–872ms
  Both sides sit at about 1s, against a 5s budget. PR-side Test Core on this head was green.
- **Where it comes from.** The describe landed on `main` today in 983abd98, without a per-test timeout. Each such test boots a fresh engine for every state, sequentially, so it is load-sensitive. The fix (an explicit timeout on that describe, or one boot per posture) belongs on `main`, not in this refactor; I am not widening the PR.
- **Recommendation.** Re-queue once. A second timeout on the same test would be the signature the triage bot aggregates.
